metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed at a wall and Valorant said ‘Yep, take this one’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I wasn't even sure what I was shooting at.
Enemy must’ve been AFK or invisible.
Click if your aim’s broken but the game still hands out kills.
Valorant logic doing its usual chaos magic.

Tap in if your kills come from pure accident!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
